# Files that already exceeded the 400-line budget on the day it landed, with
# the count each one had. `gates/LineBudget.hs` reads this and refuses three
# things: a new file over budget, a file here growing past its recorded count,
# and a row that has fallen within budget and was not deleted.
# So this is the backlog, and it is one that cannot rot: every split shows up
# as a row that must be removed, and when the last row goes the gate stops
# needing this file at all. Splitting these is the next version's work, one
# module at a time, each with the invariant it owns named — not a sweep.
# There is no command that writes this file. A new row is a human edit a
